items.title: Xavier Worthy: Opens season with three catches
items.description:
Worthy secured three of six targets for 18 yards in the Chiefs' 31-10 win over the Broncos on Monday night.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Game-long catch in Week 1 win
items.description:
Kelce brought in three of five targets for 71 yards in the Chiefs' 31-10 win over the Broncos on Monday night.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Three total TDs in season debut
items.description: Mahomes completed 15 of 27 passes for 184 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding seven rushes for 23 yards and another score in the Chiefs' 31-10 win over the Broncos on Monday night. He also recovered two fumbles.

items.title: Courtland Sutton: Limited to two catches in loss
items.description:
Sutton secured two of five targets for 11 yards in the Broncos' 31-10 loss to the Chiefs on Monday night.
